Build is where an API takes shape: you create a **project**, cut **versions** of it, and edit its
classes, properties, paths and operations in **Studio**.

Pages for this group are on the way. Until then, see the repository guides:

- [Edit classes and properties](https://github.com/apiome/apiome/blob/main/docs/guide/edit-classes-and-properties.md)
- [Edit paths and operations](https://github.com/apiome/apiome/blob/main/docs/guide/edit-paths.md)
- [Cut a version](https://github.com/apiome/apiome/blob/main/docs/guide/cut-a-version.md)
